en: Designed and developed the BUE Library website, enhancing user experience and functionality.
Led the design and maintenance of LibGuides, LibCal, and system booking websites.
Acted as Sub-Webmaster for the BUE main website, ensuring seamless performance and updates.
Created multimedia content, including videos, graphics, and promotional materials for the library’s digital presence.
Assisted with RFID technology integration, database troubleshooting, and technical reporting.
Developed virtual library tours and gamification features to enhance user engagement.
Successfully launched interactive digital platforms, boosting library user engagement and accessibility.
Produced a series of videos for the BUE Library YouTube channel, improving the university’s digital outreach.
Designed print and digital materials, including brochures, banners, and marketing collateral.
Developed product illustrations, company logos, and trademark graphics.
Collaborated with clients to understand project requirements, objectives, and budgets.
Delivered projects on time and within budget.
